title: Plugin value not shown on Wear OS 1.x
body:
The issue #595 was closed and that might be true for a complication on Wear OS 2.x
But the watchface on Wear OS 1.x still doesn't show the plugin value all the time (it sometimes does). An indicator would be nice to see when a plugin value is used.

comments.body: @nsghub Is the problem resolved, meanwhile? If not, please ask for help at the the support channels https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5 or https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus.
Closed by request due to inactivity
